notes.title: Version 1.0.3 is now available.
notes.content:
Version 1.0.3 is now available. Thank you to all who gave me feedback to improve the user experience.

[h1]WHAT'S NEW[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]Opening bio while flying[/b]: You can keep track of their health and attributes even when they are flying. But the evolution only happens on the ground.
[*] [b]Management screen[/b]: You can click the Foraging button on the bottom left to open a screen that shows the status of all the Hogragons in the ranch.
[*] [b]Feeding in the air[/b]: You can drag the food to the flying Hogragon.
[*] [b]Pet[/b]: You can use the brush to pet the Hogragon.
[/list]

If you need support, please don't hesitate to contact me via hogvalord@gmail.com.


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1829110/Hogvalord_The_Ranch/

notes.title: Hogvalord: The Ranch is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Exciting news, everyone!

The moment we’ve all been waiting for has arrived! Hogvalord: The Ranch is finally available on Steam and ready for you to explore now. ✨

Start your adventure in a faraway land, caring for the cute Hogragons, decorating the ranch, and chilling in the forest. We really hope you enjoy the game and that it becomes a special part of your cozy summer!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1829110/Hogvalord_The_Ranch/


If you run into any bugs or trouble, don't hesitate to contact us here on the Steam Forum or at hogvalord@gmail.com.

Thank you all for your incredible support and patience; we truly appreciate it. We will keep striving to make this game a pleasant experience.

notes.title: Demo Improvement & Release Date
notes.content:
Hey everyone! We hope you're having a great day.

Steam Next Fest has come to an end. It was our first time participating in such a big event on Steam, and it was a lot of fun. We want to extend our thanks to all the players who tried out our demo and added our game to their wishlist. A big shout-out to those who provided feedback - it's incredibly valuable, and we can't thank you enough!

Based on the feedback received, we have made some improvements to the demo version. Here are the changes:
[list]
[*] You can now use Left Shift + Click to feed all Hogragons at once. If there aren't enough of the chosen items for all Hogragons, the mechanic will prioritize feeding the hungry ones first.
[*] The Hogragons are now slightly more durable and will lose less HP when they're starving.
[*] The Hogragon's status window will no longer switch off automatically. You can now see live updates of their attributes.
[/list]

The demo will be available until the official launch. We are gearing up for the full release on July 13th at 5 PM PDT. Hope to see you there!

notes.title: Announcement Trailer & Improvements
notes.content:
Hello everyone! We hope you’re all having a good day!
Here’s a quick update on what we’ve been up to since our last post.

Have you seen our demo trailer yet? It was out 2 months ago. Well, if you haven’t… That’s great too! Because we’ve just wrapped up a new one, with all the touch-ups and key features included.

[previewyoutube=slkxfmT7fvc;full][/previewyoutube]

As you can see in the new trailer, we continue to make improvements on the visuals. We received feedback suggesting that while the game was quite cute, it had a somewhat gloomy vibe. That wasn’t what we were going for, so we reworked on the lighting and colors again. And we are thrilled with the results. This little game is becoming more polished each passing day. We had joy developing it, and we hope it will bring you joy too. Here are a few screenshots to give you a glimpse:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43224022/5433dad19f1fd7cc86375aa37092e79ae1843564.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43224022/28c23e1f7adbc2377a1f2ecaecaa3418f180fa1a.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43224022/8c02215a5013da8456fa6de3ced56529cbaf7a62.png[/img]

As for what's next? Well, since the game is technically 100% complete, it's all about those final touches. Perhaps we'll try signing up for a festival or two!

That’s all for today. We will continue to share more updates and details in the future. Thank you for your continued support of Hogvalord. Stick around for more news, everyone!

notes.title: AN ADORABLE TOWN HALL
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43224022/c802a3e4035fe5eea581b3089da35c7303eec965.png[/img]

Dear players!

You may not know about one of the essential features of Hogvalord: The Ranch. That is building. Hogvalord: The Ranch is a small and cute game. But it doesn't mean it lacks fun from decorating your ranch with adorable constructions.

Today, I want to introduce you to the Town Hall. Town Hall is one of the most charming constructions you can build. It helps to enhance the beauty of your ranch to the next level. It also has an impact on the gameplay with its unique features.

[previewyoutube=MzZn1efnebg;full][/previewyoutube]

One example that can help you a lot is the janitorial service. You can activate this service via the Town Hall tab of the Management window. You might wonder why you need this service. Well! The answer is sanitation is very crucial to keep your pets healthy and happy.


There are more things you will discover while playing Hogvalord: The Ranch. I think that's enough for today's post, and I hope you guys will love this game when it releases.

notes.title: HEY! LOOK AT THESE EGGS
notes.content:
Dear players!

This short clip is my latest result from the development progress of Hogvalord: The Ranch. To be honest! I feel a little bit proud of this humble result.

[previewyoutube=fjflzLye6H0;full][/previewyoutube]

As you can see, what I would like to mention in this clip is the hatching egg feature. The idea about this feature is out of the original plan. But I would love to bring you the best experience, so I tried my best to put it into the game.

You can buy the egg from the Shop, and then your egg will appear in your ranch. It will be stored in the inventory if there are no more places for it. You only need to click on the egg to see what will happen.

My first thought when the idea rose was our excitement when the egg hatched. I didn't realize this simple idea was more complicated than its look. I spent a whole week solving the conflict between the new thing and the existing in-game elements.

Fortunately, the result seems pretty good. I hope you guys will like this game when it launches. In the meantime, please wishlist Hogvalord: The Ranch on Steam.

notes.title: February 2023 Devlog
notes.content:
Hi there, everyone!

It’s been quite some time since we last showed up, we hope you are well and still as passionate about farming and ranching as ever. As usual, we were buried under Mount Workload, working diligently behind the scene to make sure that this project remained on track. Our debutante’s date is still undefined, but rest assured, we are still very much active and moving forward.

Now let us dive a bit deeper into details of what is going on. The core game is pretty much finished. Three out of four main features - raising hogragons, evolving them, building & decorating - are already there. Currently, we have been focused on designing the items in the game. While Hogvalord 1 has only around 10 essential items, Hogvalord: The Ranch has up to 40+ food and drinks to collect. We invested into art quality as well, they are all prettily hand painted. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43224022/e103fed6921ae54a0220d87d9e6ef3c337f479d5.png[/img]

And what’s more, the items here aren’t just stuff you buy from shops, but they also play an important part in the evolving and crafting system.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43224022/58eb768379b5a7e4a633d33b3bdf3494ab772602.png[/img]

That’s it for today. We will continue to share more updates and details in the future. Thank you for your continued support of Hogvalord. Stick around for more news, everyone!
